subject: HANDOFF Gen7 PresentationHinge Core V1 conformance review: presentation-age cadence defect + control-law gaps
body: WORKSTREAM_STATE=COMPLETE. CURRENT_MAIN_SHA=633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44 rechecked at handoff and unchanged. Exact Primary Core V1 checksums PASS and baseline harness PASS. Disposition for this bounded control-law lane: CHANGES_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PROMOTION; architecture direction remains viable. P1 corroborated: REACQUIRE is fixed 50 ms + linear slew, not directive-required error-shaped critical damping; reproduced residual 0.648567 after mode exit in a large-gap case. P2 NEW: freshness/confidence uses callbackTime-deliveryTime while prediction targets expectedPresent+lead; with identical trusted state and identical target presentation=160 ms, a 60-Hz-like callback yields TRACKING/confidence=1.0 while a 120-Hz-like callback yields BLACKOUT_PREDICT/confidence=0.968992. Control-law age should be source age at target presentation in the normalized clock domain; callback delivery age should remain transport diagnostics. P3: directive-required bounded acceleration/jerk is not implemented or exposed; source has speed caps only. P4: fresh tracking reports confidence=1.0 after only two samples, with no fit/sample-count/disagreement quality term. P5: PIPELINE_LEAD_NS=8 ms is architecturally allowed but MODEL-only pending Fold7 measurement/adaptive evidence. Positive: normalized visual-only progress, horizon caps, blackout lead cap, degraded hold, reversal horizon collapse all survive review. No production patch proposed; no CI/device claim.
recommended_manager_action: Require Core V2 to add presentation-time freshness/confidence semantics, error-gated critically-damped reacquisition, explicit acceleration/jerk bounds, and confidence-quality tests before promotion; field-tune numeric envelopes later.
